case.summary: Investigation into card C06343-K1 identified two fraudulent online transactions totaling $224.86 on 2016-12-25 and 2016-12-26. sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-22 and 2016-12-29, a specific Huawei device profile (FRD-L09 Build/HUAWEIFRD-L09) was used to conduct online transactions across eight different cards. On 2016-12-25, an unauthorized transaction of $149.93 (ID 3573558) was made on card C06343-K1 belonging to cardholder C06343. This was followed by a second unauthorized transaction of $74.93 (ID 3576545) on 2016-12-26. Analysis revealed that this device was linked to nine cardholders in total, including C02515-K2 and C13284-K1, generating nine transactions amounting to $974.91. The use of a single device across multiple unrelated accounts is a known indicator of coordinated card-not-present fraud. The transactions utilized an anonymous email domain, further suggesting suspicious intent. The bank has blocked card C06343-K1 and initiated monitoring for all connected accounts to prevent further loss. This report is filed because the activity connects to a shared device profile and involves multiple cardholders, meeting the criteria for suspicious coordinated abuse.
